panels.title: Status now
panels.description: Whether the latest run of the uptime check succeeded from every probe. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Share of check runs that succeeded over the selected range, across all probes. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Check duration
panels.description: Average time for one check run (DNS, connect, TLS, response) over the selected range. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Failed check runs
panels.description: Check runs that failed over the selected range, across all probes. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: Page loads recorded by the RUM script in visitors' browsers. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Page load (p75)
panels.description: Navigation duration: from request until the page finished loading. 75% of page loads were at or below this. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: LCP (p75)
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint: when the main content became visible. Good ≤ 2.5 s, poor > 4 s. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: CLS (p75)
panels.description: Cumulative Layout Shift: how much the page jumped while loading. Good ≤ 0.1, poor > 0.25. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: INP (p75)
panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint: delay between a click or tap and the page responding. Good ≤ 200 ms, poor > 500 ms. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: JavaScript errors
panels.description: Uncaught errors thrown in visitors' browsers. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Page views and browser errors (hourly)
panels.description: Page views, JavaScript errors and failed requests made by the page, per hour. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Total requests CloudFront served in the selected range. Includes page assets and bots, so requests are not visitors. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: Data served
panels.description: Total bytes CloudFront sent to viewers in the selected range. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: 4xx rate (incl. firewall blocks)
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 4xx status (for example 403 or 404). This includes requests AWS WAF blocked (see Security) and bot requests for paths that do not exist. Use 5xx and availability to judge site health. Weighted by requests: per minute, errors = rate × requests; the panel shows total errors ÷ total requests, so quiet minutes with a single failed request don't dominate. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: 5xx error rate
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status: CloudFront or the origin failed. Should stay near 0. Weighted by requests: per minute, errors = rate × requests; the panel shows total errors ÷ total requests, so quiet minutes with a single failed request don't dominate. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: Requests over time
panels.description: Requests per period. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: Error rates (hourly)
panels.description: Hourly share of requests returning 4xx and 5xx. Weighted by requests: per minute, errors = rate × requests; the panel shows total errors ÷ total requests, so quiet minutes with a single failed request don't dominate. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

panels.title: Data served over time
panels.description: Bytes sent to viewers (downloaded) and received from them (uploaded). Measured · CloudWatch AWS/CloudFront (us-east-1) · distribution ${distribution}.

options.content:
**Signal type:** Measured. Every panel's ⓘ names its source.

**Site:** `https://atla.in/`. Portfolio: Next.js static export in S3 behind CloudFront (Free plan, AWS WAF included).

**Availability:** Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check `atla.in homepage`, every 5 minutes from 3 probes.

**Real visitors:** CloudWatch RUM app monitor `atla-in` (no cookies, all sessions).

**Delivery:** CloudWatch `AWS/CloudFront` in `us-east-1`, distribution `E2OMRFTQ27WGMZ`, one-minute data points, usually a few minutes behind. Requests count every file fetched and include bots, so they are not visitors.

**Security:** AWS WAF web ACL `CreatedByCloudFront-14eef7b4`. Blocked requests return 403 and are also counted in the 4xx rate.

**Deploy markers:** blue vertical lines, posted by the site's GitHub Actions deploy.

**Not shown:** request logs (not collected).

panels.title: Blocked by firewall
panels.description: Requests AWS WAF stopped before they reached the site, answered with 403. This is the firewall working, not the site failing. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed by firewall
panels.description: Requests WAF let through to CloudFront and S3. Includes bots the managed rules do not recognise. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Share blocked
panels.description: Blocked ÷ (blocked + allowed) over the selected range. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed vs blocked (hourly)
panels.description: Requests per hour by WAF decision. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocks by managed rule
panels.description: Which AWS managed rule matched blocked requests (for example path traversal, missing user agent, exploitable paths, bad IP reputation). Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocked by country
panels.description: Countries the blocked requests came from, based on source IP. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed by country
panels.description: Countries of requests WAF allowed. Includes unrecognised bots, so it approximates, not measures, visitor location. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocked by attack type
panels.description: WAF's classification of blocked requests. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (us-east-1) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.
